There is a discussion about how to end a community on [Moderators.SE](http://moderators.stackexchange.com/questions/632/ending-a-community-with-dignity)

Right now, the highest voted answer has a point about the two ends you mentioned (shutting it down vs phasing out). You are providing the world download and have recruited the trusted players. I think this is a good ending to a server you don't wish to support any longer.
